source.existing_tests: TestScanRegion (scanRegion helper): a..c contiguous, c..e hole, g..h containing, m..infinity; TestScanRegionLimit tests BatchScanRegions, not direct ScanRegions.
source.derivation: All expected IDs are derived from current ScanRegions source: scan starts at containing or next region; stops if nonempty end <= region.start, or positive limit reached. Nonpositive limits unbounded. Equal/reversed bounds follow literal start-key check (e..e includes containing d..f). Iterator forwards scanRange and stops after callback false. These cases are source-derived, not executed Go differential cases.
